description: NASMHPD WILL SERVE AS A COLLABORATOR AND PROVIDE STRATEGIC GUIDANCE AND SUBJECT MATTER EXPERTISE FOR THE SMI TRAINING AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE CENTER. NASMHPD WILL CONTRIBUTE THEIR KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE IN SMI TO SUPPORT THE SMI TTAC TA DELIVERY AND THOUGHT LEADERSHIP ACROSS MULTIPLE TASKS. SMI TTAC IS FUNDED BY THE SUBSTANCE USE AND MENTAL HEALTH SERVICES ADMINISTRATION (SAMHSA), WHO HAS APPROVED NASMHPD AS A SUBCONTRACTOR IN BOTH THE PROPOSAL AND CONTRACT. BECAUSE NASMHPD’S MEMBERSHIP INCLUDES EXECUTIVES REPRESENTING PUBLIC MENTAL HEALTH SERVICE DELIVERY SYSTEM, THEIR CONTRIBUTIONS TO SMI TTAC WILL BE CRITICAL TO ENSURING TA EFFORTS AND OFFERINGS ALIGN WITH THE NEEDS OF PROVIDERS AND ADMINISTRATORS ACROSS THE FIELD. NASMHPD WILL ALSO USE THEIR EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE OF WORKING WITH SAMHSA, NATIONAL COUNCIL, AND SUBJECT MATTER EXPERTS TO PROVIDE THOUGHT LEADERSHIP AND SUPPORT CONSULTATIVE MONITORING BOARD ESTABLISHMENT, SELECT PERSONALIZED INTENSIVE TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE (PITA) DELIVERY, SELECT TA PLANNING AND EXECUTION, LEARNING COLLABORATIVES, AND VIRTUAL WEBINARS. NASMHPD WORKS WITH STATES, FEDERAL PARTNERS, AND STAKEHOLDERS TO PROMOTE WELLNESS, RECOVERY, AND RESILIENCY FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH MENTAL HEALTH CONDITIONS OR CO-OCCURRING MENTAL HEALTH AND SUBSTANCE RELATED DISORDERS ACROSS ALL AGES AND CULTURAL GROUPS, INCLUDING: YOUTH, OLDER PERSONS, VETERANS AND THEIR FAMILIES, AND PEOPLE UNDER THE JURISDICTION OF THE COURT. description: THE KEY GOALS OF THIS PROGRAM ARE TO DEMONSTRATE DETECTION OF GONORRHEA FROM CRUDE VAGINAL SWAB AND URINE SAMPLES AND DEMONSTRATE PROOF-OF-FEASIBILITY FOR THE STI SCOUT, A PRODUCT INTENDED FOR AT HOME AND POINT-OF-NEED TESTING FOR GONORRHEA AND CHLAMYDIA. THE TARGET PATHOGENS ARE NEISSERIA GONORRHOEAE AND CHLAMYDIA TRACHOMATIS. THE KEY CLINICAL INDICATIONS ARE SYMPTOMATIC AND ASYMPTOMATIC INFECTIONS OR SUSPECTED INFECTIONS OF THE UROGENITAL TRACT BY CHLAMYDIA OR GONORRHEA, THE TWO MOST COMMON, TREATABLE SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED INFECTIONS IN THE UNITED STATES. SCOUT IS TARGETING DIFFERENTIATION AGAINST OTHER APPROACHES BY OFFERING PCR-LEVEL ACCURACY WITH THE CONVENIENCE AND COST OF RAPID ANTIGEN TESTING. UNLIKE COLLECT-AT-HOME AND SEND-IN TESTING OPTIONS, STI SCOUT DELIVERS RESULTS IMMEDIATELY TO THE USER (WITHIN 30 MINUTES). THE SCOUT HUB IS A REUSABLE DEVICE THAT ENABLES TESTING FOR MULTIPLE INDICATIONS, NOT JUST STIS, ADDING A VALUABLE TOOL TO INDIVIDUALSÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢ OR CLINICSÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢ TOOLKIT FOR DIAGNOSING COMMON, TREATABLE ILLNESSES OR INFORMING ON OVERALL WELLNESS. A MOBILE APPLICATION, SCOUT CONNECT, PERMITS RESULT TRACKING, SHARING, AND FOLLOW-ON CARE VIA TELEHEALTH AND E-PRESCRIPTIONS FROM QUALIFIED HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS. A PLANNED REFLEX TEST FOR NG AMR WILL ENABLE BETTER STEWARDSHIP OF ANTIBIOTICS.

description: THIS PROJECT IS FOCUSSED ON DEVELOPING AND CHARACTERISING ASSAYS FOR CHLAMYDIA (CT) AND GONORRHOEA (NG) THAT ARE SUITABLE FOR INTEGRATION INTO FUSE'S APEX CT/NG, A NEXT-GENERATION, INSTRUMENT-FREE MOLECULAR DIAGNOSTIC TEST. EXISTING TESTS ARE UNSUITABLE FOR THE WIDESPREAD, FLEXIBLE DEPLOYMENT NECESSARY TO COMBAT THE NG EPIDEMIC, DUE TO THE LOGISTICAL COMPLEXITY OF CENTRALIZED APPROACHES AND THE OPERATIONAL CONSTRAINTS INHERENT IN INSTRUMENTED PLATFORMS. LAB PCR TESTS EXHIBIT GOLD-STANDARD PERFORMANCE BUT REQUIRE SPECIALIST EQUIPMENT AND COMPLEX LOGISTICS WHICH HAMPERS ADOPTION AND MEANS THAT RESULTS ARE NOT AVAILABLE IN TIME TO INFORM EFFECTIVE TREATMENT OR MANAGEMENT DECISIONS. RAPID LATERAL FLOW TESTS ARE CONVENIENT, LOW-COST SOLUTIONS WELL SUITED TO WIDESPREAD DEPLOYMENT, BUT THEIR SENSITIVITY IS INSUFFICIENT FOR CT/NG. COMPETITORS HAVE MADE SUBSTANTIAL INVESTMENTS TO ATTEMPT TO BRING MOLECULAR TESTS FOR CT/NG OUTSIDE OF THE CENTRAL LAB BY DEVELOPING 'NEAR-PATIENT' PLATFORM INSTRUMENTS. WHILST SUCH PRODUCTS ARE EASIER TO USE, THEIR REQUIREMENT FOR A TEST MACHINE MEANS THEY DO NOT YET MEET THE CRITERIA FOR A DECENTRALIZED TEST. INSTRUMENT-FREE MOLECULAR DIAGNOSTICS PROMISE TO ADDRESS THIS CHALLENGE BY COMBINING THE BENEFITS OF LAB PCR WITH THE FLEXIBILITY OF A DISPOSABLE DEVICE FOR DECENTRALISED USE. SUCH TESTS CAN BE READILY ADOPTED IN A WIDE RANGE OF LOCATIONS, INCLUDING SMALL CLINICS AND PHARMACIES, AND PERFORMED BY A WIDE RANGE OF END USERS WITHOUT TRAINING. APEX CT/NG IS A NEXT-GENERATION INSTRUMENT-FREE MOLECULAR DIAGNOSTIC TEST THAT COMBINES INNOVATIVE DEVICE DESIGNS AND MOLECULAR TECHNOLOGIES TO FUNDAMENTALLY REDUCE THE COST-OF-GOODS AND SIZE OF THE TEST. IT WILL DELIVER LAB PCR ACCURACY IN AN ULTRA-RAPID (<10 MIN) DEVICE, IDEALLY SUITED TO WIDESPREAD DEPLOYMENT.

description: IN THIS CARB-X PROJECT, WE AIM AT DEVELOPING OUR NOVEL CLASS OF COMPOUNDS TARGETING THE BACTERIAL SLIDING CLAMP (DNAN) AS ANTIBIOTIC LEAD CANDIDATES FOR THE TREATMENT OF GRAM-POSITIVE BACTERIAL INFECTIONS. IT WILL BE GUIDED BY A PRIMARY TPP OF A STANDALONE THERAPY FOR THE TREATMENT OF COMMUNITY ACQUIRED BACTERIAL PNEUMONIA (CABP) CAUSED BY SUSCEPTIBLE AS WELL AS MULTIDRUG-RESISTANT (MDR) STREPTOCOCCUS PNEUMONIAE. WITHIN THE FRAME OF CARB-X FUNDING FOR THIS HIT-TO-LEAD BASE STAGE, WE WILL FOCUS IN THE FIRST PLACE ON THREE GOALS, NAMELY OPTIMIZATION OF TARGET AFFINITY AND ANTIBACTERIAL ACTIVITY AGAINST MAINLY TWO KEY GRAM-POSITIVE TPP PATHOGENS (STREPTOCOCCUS PNEUMONIAE AND STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS), DEMONSTRATION OF TARGET ENGAGEMENT IN A GRAM-POSITIVE BACTERIAL STRAIN, AND PROOF-OF-CONCEPT IN A MURINE INFECTION MODEL. IF THESE AIMS ARE ACHIEVED, WE WILL THEN CONCENTRATE ON OPTIMIZATION OF BOTH THE PHARMACOKINETIC (PK) PROPERTIES AND THE ANTIBIOTIC SPECTRUM OF OUR COMPOUND CLASS IN ORDER TO COVER OTHER GRAM-POSITIVE TPP-RELEVANT GERMS, INCLUDING MDR CLINICAL ISOLATES, AS WELL AS OPPORTUNISTIC GRAM-NEGATIVE PATHOGENS INVOLVED IN CABP INFECTIONS. MOREOVER, WE WILL IMPLEMENT IN VITRO SAFETY PHARMACOLOGY AGAINST HUMAN OFF-TARGETS AND IN VIVO SAFETY AND EFFICACY PROFILING TO IDENTIFY THE MOST PROMISING 2Ã¢Â‚¬Â€Œ3 LEAD CANDIDATES. THE ENVISAGED LEAD COMPOUNDS WILL DEMONSTRATE POTENT ANTIBIOTIC ACTIVITY AGAINST MULTIPLE GRAM-POSITIVE STRAINS, IN VITRO AND IN CELLUO TARGET ENGAGEMENT, PROMISING IN VITRO ADME-TOX PROFILE, AS WELL AS FAVORABLE IN VIVO PK AND PHARMACODYNAMICS (PD) PROPERTIES.

description: BETWEEN SEPTEMBER 15, 2024 – SEPTEMBER 14, 2025, NASMHPD WILL WORK WITH THE PROJECT TEAM TO PROVIDE SUPPORT TO THE PROJECT. TASKS WILL INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO: TASK ORDER 2 · DIRECT CONSULTATION AND INDIVIDUAL TA: COLLABORATE WITH THE NATIONAL COUNCIL TO PROVIDE DIRECT CONSULTATION AND INDIVIDUAL TA TO STATE OFFICIALS. PROVIDE SUBJECT MATTER EXPERTISE (SME) REGARDING STATE TA REQUESTS RELATED TO CCBHCS AND IDENTIFY EXISTING RESOURCES AS ABLE. PROVIDE THE NATIONAL COUNCIL WITH A SHORT SUMMARY OF THE TA PROVIDED HIGHLIGHTING THE TA ISSUE ADDRESSES, TOPICS COVERED AND RECOMMENDATIONS. WORK WITH THE NATIONAL COUNCIL S-TAC PROJECT TEAM TO FOLLOW ANY DEVELOPED PROTOCOL AND OR STANDARD PRACTICE FOR ORGANIZING AND PROVIDING TA TO STATES AS NEEDED. · LEARNING COLLABORATIVE: COLLABORATE WITH THE NATIONAL COUNCIL TO SERVE AS A SME AND PANELIST IN ONE LEARNING COLLABORATIVE THAT WILL FOCUS ON SUPPORTING THE NEW COHORT OF CCBHC PLANNING GRANT STATES AWARDED IN DECEMBER 2024 AS THEY PREPARE AND PLAN FOR THEIR CCBHC EFFORTS AND APPLICATION FOR THE CCBHC DEMONSTRATION. O ATTEND UP TO ALL SIX (6) 90-MINUTE SESSIONS TO PROVIDE SME AS NEEDED DURING THE SESSIONS. FOR SESSIONS WHERE NASMHPD IS NOT AN ASSIGNED PRESENTER, NO PREPARATION IS NEEDED. · CCBHC MONTHLY STATE MEETINGS: ATTEND AND PROVIDE SME DURING VIRTUAL CCBHC MONTHLY STATE MEETINGS; UP TO TWO SESSIONS AS A PRESENTER, AND THE REMAINING 9 AS AN ATTENDEE AND NOT A PRESENTER (NO PREP NEEDED FOR SESSIONS NOT ASSIGNED AS A PRESENTER). description: CELLULAR IMMUNITY, LARGELY REGULATED BY CD4+ T CELLS, IS REQUIRED IN CONTROL OF INFECTION WITH THE PATHOGENIC FUNGUS BLASTOMYCES DERMATITIDIS. WE PROPOSE TO IDENTIFY HUMAN CD4+ T CELL EPITOPES OF B. DERMATITIDIS. WE WILL INVESTIGATE SYNTHETIC PEPTIDES FROM VARIOUS "FAST TRACK" ANTIGENS, INCLUDING CALNEXIN, BAD1, BYS1, PRA1, ZRT1, AND BL-ENG2, AS WELL AS NINE PRODUCTS REPORTED TO BE TRANSCRIPTIONALLY INCREASED DURING INFECTION IN MACROPHAGES IN VITRO AND MICE DURING PULMONARY INFECTION. ADDITIONAL GENE PRODUCTS REPORTEDLY UPREGULATED IN THOSE MODELS MAY ALSO BE STUDIED. SYNTHETIC PEPTIDES OF THE PRODUCTS ABOVE WILL BE SCREENED INITIALLY FOR THEIR IMMUNOGENICITY/RECOGNITION IN HLA-DR4 TRANSGENIC MICE AND THOSE OR RELATED PEPTIDES FURTHER ANALYZED/CONFIRMED FOR RECOGNITION BY HUMANS THAT HAVE BEEN INFECTED WITH B. DERMATITIDIS. IMMUNE RESPONSES IN THE MICE AND IN HUMANS WILL BE MEASURED BY STANDARD ASSAYS FOR CYTOKINE AND CELLULAR RESPONSE. AT THE END OF THIS PROJECT, WE WILL HAVE IDENTIFIED HUMAN CD4+ T CELL EPITOPES OF ANTIGENS FROM B. DERMATITIDIS AND DEPOSITED INFORMATION ABOUT THESE PEPTIDE SEQUENCES INTO THE IMMUNE EPITOPE DATABASE (IEDB.ORG).

description: SERVING AS PROXIMAL SPOKES, THE NATIONAL SMART IRB AMBASSADORS ARE ESSENTIAL CONTRIBUTORS TO BI-DIRECTIONAL COMMUNICATION BETWEEN THE CTSAS, TINS, IRBS, RESEARCH TEAMS, INSTITUTIONS AND THE SMART IRB TEAM. DURING THE FIRST PHASE OF SMART IRB, THE AMBASSADORS SUCCESSFULLY BUILT TRUST WITH CONSTITUENTS, DROVE AND ENABLED SIGN-ON TO THE SMART IRB AGREEMENT, AND SERVED AS AN ESSENTIAL RESOURCE FOR TRAININGS, WORKFLOW DEVELOPMENT, AND DISSEMINATION OF RESOURCES. THE SMART IRB AMBASSADORS WILL CONTINUE TO REPRESENT THEIR HOME INSTITUTIONS AND OTHER CTSAS AS ASSIGNED AS WELL AS WILL WORK WITH OTHER AMBASSADORS TO BRING POSITIVE CHANGE TO ALL INSTITUTIONS INVOLVED. IN ADDITION, SMART IRB AMBASSADORS WILL SERVE AS DOMAIN EXPERTS, RESPECTED BY THEIR PEERS, AND WORK COLLABORATIVELY TO COLLECT FEEDBACK FROM USERS, REPRESENT SMART IRB ON NATIONAL COMMITTEES, AND DESIGN AND CONDUCT PILOT STUDIES OF POTENTIALLY HARMONIZED POLICIES AND PROCESSES. IMPORTANTLY, SMART IRB AMBASSADORS WILL ALSO IDENTIFY A CADRE OF EXPERIENCED SUPER USERS TO ASSIST IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF TRAININGS AND MATERIALS ORIENTED TOWARD PREPARING STUDY TEAMS FOR A SMOOTH TRANSITION TO SINGLE IRB REVIEW. IN TURN, THE SMART IRB AMBASSADORS WILL BE A KEY COMPONENT TO DEVELOPING MATERIALS FOR, AND ENCOURAGE THE ADOPTION OF, THE SMART IRB RELIANCE LEARNING COMPENDIUM AND THE NATIONAL COMMON REGULATORY PORTFOLIO.

description: IN SUPPORT OF THE MULTI-INSTITUTIONAL EFFORT TO CHARACTERIZE T CELL EPITOPES OF FUNGI, IOGENETICS WILL APPLY ITS EIGENBIO IMMUNOINFORMATICS PLATFORM TO PROVIDE DETAILED EPITOPE MAPS AND RANKINGS. THIS WILL BE DONE IN TWO WAYS. FIRST A GROUP OF "FAST TRACK" PROTEINS HAS BEEN SELECTED BY THE MYCOLOGISTS IN EACH PARTICIPATING UNIVERSITY . FOR THESE PROTEINS IOGENETICS WILL PROCEED DIRECTLY TO GENERATE DETAILED IMMUNOME MAPS AND TO IDENTIFY PROBABLE T CELL EPITOPES THAT WILL BE RESTRICTED BY MHC II OF THE DR1*0401 ALLELE AS WELL AS FOR A SERIES OF OTHER HUMAN MHC 1 1 ALLELES. SECONDLY A RATIONAL DOWN SELECTION APPROACH WILL BE USED TO PROVIDE AN UNBIASED APPROACH TO IDENTIFYING OTHER T CELL EPITOPES . THE TOTAL PROTEOME OF EACH OF FOUR FUNGAL SPECIES, BLASTOMYCES DERMATITIDIS, HISTOP/ASMA CAPSULATUM, COCCIDIOIDES POSADASII AND CRYPTOCOCCUS NEOFORMANS WILL BE FILTERED BASED ON EXPRESSION IN ITS PARASITIC PHASE, UPREGULATION AND PRESENCE OF OTHER FEATURES SUCH AS SURFACE EXPOSURE TO IDENTIFY PROTEINS MOST LIKELY TO CARRY RELEVANT T CELL EPITOPES. THE PROTEOMES WILL BE SCREENED TO IDENTIFY IMMUNOSTIMULATORY VS IMMUNOSUPPRESSIVE PROTEINS. BASE DON THIS A SET OF 100-200 PROTEINS WILL BE SELECTED FOR EACH FUNGUS AND SUBJECT TO THE DETAILED MAPPING DESCRIBED FOR THE FAST TRACK GROUP. IN BOTH CASES THE GOAL IS TO IDENTIFY EXTENDED EPITOPE RICH PEPTIDES WHICH CAN BE EVALUATED AND VALIDATED IN MICE, HUMAN PATIENTS AND IN VITRO. IOGENETICS EFFORTS WILL BE MOST INTENSE IN THE FIRST TWO YEARS OF THE PROJECT FOLLOWED BY ONGOING ANALYSIS OF RESULTS AND TROUBLE SHOOTING DURING THE OUT YEARS OF THE PROJECT.

description: FOR EACH VIRAL FAMILY, JCVI WILL DEFINE SETS OF HIGHLY- AND MODERATELY-CONSERVED REGIONS FOR EACH PROTEIN AND TAXONOMIC GROUP, PARSED INTO CONSERVED 9-MER, 10-MER, AND 15-MER PEPTIDES. ACCORDINGLY, TO BIOINFORMATICALLY CHARACTERIZE THE SEQUENCE CONSERVATION OF IDENTIFIED EPITOPES ACROSS DIFFERENT VIRAL VARIANTS AND DIFFERENT VIRAL SPECIES DERIVED FROM EACH OF THE VIRAL FAMILIES OF CONCERN, WE WILL: 1. USE THE CD-HIT ALGORITHM TO CONTROL FOR THE IMPACT OF SAMPLING BIAS ON ESTIMATES, ENABLING US TO BOTH PROVIDE EFFECTIVE COVERAGE AND OPTIMAL T CELL INDUCTION, WHILE AT THE SAME TIME ALLOWING US TO ANTICIPATE THE NEXT OUTBREAK THAT COULD EMERGE FROM OTHER SOURCE SPECIES. 2. DOWNLOAD SEQUENCES FOR EACH OF THE PROTEINS FROM DIFFERENT VIRAL ISOLATES FROM THE BV-BRC DATABASE. SEQUENCES WILL BE PROCESSED USING CD-HIT AT DIFFERENT SIMILARITY THRESHOLDS. 3. EVALUATE THE RESULTING SEQUENCE SETS BY PHYLOGENETIC ANALYSIS TO SELECT THE OPTIMAL SEQUENCE SIMILARITY THRESHOLD THAT PROVIDES FOR EQUAL REPRESENTATION OF SEQUENCES WITH LONG AND SHORT BRANCH LENGTHS. 4. PRODUCE A COLLECTION OF SEQUENCES FOR EACH OF THE PROTEINS AND TAXONOMIC GROUPS THAT EQUALLY REPRESENTS THE SEQUENCE DIVERSITY OF THE GROUP. 5. UTILIZE MUSCLE TO ALIGN PROTEIN SEQUENCES FROM EACH COLLECTION. 6. CALCULATE THE EXTENT OF SEQUENCE CONSERVATION/VARIATION AT EACH ALIGNED POSITION USING THREE METRICS: PERCENT IDENTITY TO THE CONSENSUS RESIDUE, AVERAGE BLOSUM SCORE IN COMPARISON WITH THE CONSENSUS RESIDUE, AND ENTROPY SCORE. 7. IDENTIFY PROTEIN REGIONS OF CONSERVATION USING THE MEDIAN VALUE OF EACH OF THESE METRICS IN A SLIDING WINDOW OF 10 RESIDUES. 8. EVALUATE THE DISTRIBUTIONS OF EACH METRIC TO ESTABLISH CUTOFFS FOR DEFINING REGIONS WITH HIGH AND MODERATE SEQUENCE CONSERVATION FOR EACH OF THE PROTEIN AND TAXONOMIC GROUPS, AND THE RESULTS COMBINED TO DERIVE A CONSENSUS CONSERVATION SCORE. IF THE APPROACH FOR SELECTING CONSERVATION SCORE CUTOFFS PRODUCES TOO MANY OR TOO FEW CANDIDATE REGIONS, WE WILL MANUALLY ADJUST THE CONSERVATION SCORE CUTOFFS TO PRODUCE A REASONABLE NUMBER OF CANDIDATE EPITOPES/REGIONS. 9. DERIVE CONSENSUS REGION/SEQUENCE FOR EACH GROUP, AND THEN PARSE EACH INTO 9-MER, 10-MER, AND 15-MER PEPTIDES. 10. PREPARE REPORTS REGARDING THE SEQUENCE CONSERVATION ANALYSIS FOR SUBMISSION TO NIH. 11. CONTRIBUTE TO MANUSCRIPT PREPARATION DESCRIBING THE ANALYSIS FOR SCIENTIFIC PUBLICATION IN PEER-REVIEWED JOURNALS. 12. PARTICIPATE IN ANNUAL SCIENTIFIC REVIEW MEETINGS AS NEEDED.

description: THIS SCOPE OF WORK FOR THIS SUBCONTRACT IS TO PROVIDE SENIOR PROJECT MANAGEMENT SUPPORT TO ALL ACTIVITIES RELATED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF A RWD INFRASTRUCTURE THAT WILL LEVERAGE RWD ACROSS MULTIPLE ORGANIZATIONS TO ENABLE THE DEVELOPMENT OF A COMBINED, LINKED, DE-IDENTIFIED INFRASTRUCTURE THAT WOULD BE AVAILABLE TO THE BROADER RESEARCH COMMUNITY TO BEGIN TO ANSWER MANY OF THESE QUESTIONS RELATED TO DURABILITY OF PROTECTION AMONG VACCINATED VERSUS NATIVELY ACQUIRED INFECTION; DURATION OF PROTECTION AMONG HIGH-RISK SUBPOPULATIONS SUCH AS CANCER PATIENTS AND/OR OTHER IMMUNOCOMPROMISED POPULATIONS. THE PROPOSED INFRASTRUCTURE WOULD CONSIST OF A PHASED APPROACH COMBINING LONGITUDINAL DATA IN A COMMON PLATFORM THAT WOULD INTEGRATE CLINICAL LABORATORY DATA ON SARS-COV-2 (BOTH PCR AND SEROLOGIC TESTS), VACCINATION STATUS OF PATIENTS INCLUDED, CLINICAL INFORMATION ON HOSPITALIZATION, SEVERITY OF ILLNESS, AND COMORBID CONDITIONS TO ENABLE A TIERED SYSTEM OF DATA ASSETS. IN ADDITION, TO PROVIDE SENIOR PROJECT MANAGEMENT SUPPORT TO ALL ACTIVITIES RELATED TO THE EXPANSION OF REAL WORLD DATA PROJECT ASSESSING THE IMPACT OF SARS-COV-2 INFECTION ON CANCER INCIDENCE WITH AN EMPHASIS ON UNDERSTANDING THE ROLE OF SEROLOGICAL RESPONSE PROJECT.
